name: Hanford Direct-Feed High-Level Waste 2025 Supplement Analysis
known_limitations: The supplement traces DOE's Direct-Feed High-Level Waste implementation decision to the 2023 analysis of alternatives. It does not document the pause, mission-need reset, independent optimization analysis, or safety-prerequisite package required by the open GAO recommendation.
